name: Redline
tagline: Mark up a landing page like a doc.
author: Switchboard

tools.name: audit
tools.description: Run Redline's self-audit on a landing page — pins the worst findings (AI-slop copy, dead sections, weak headlines), each with a ready-to-stage fix. Pass `page` (a filename) to open+audit that page when driving Redline cold; omit to audit the page already open. Returns the findings.

inputSchema.page: string — optional page filename (e.g. landing-grid.html) to open before auditing; omit to use the open/preferred page.

tools.name: stage
tools.description: Stage the recommended fix for an audit finding by its number — or every ready finding if no number is given. Shows live on the canvas but writes nothing until the human says 'check now'. Returns what was staged.

inputSchema.num: number — the finding number to stage; omit to stage all ready findings.
inputSchema.page: string — optional page filename to open first when driving cold.

inside: A line-by-line review of any page or doc
Audit and respond as two headless workflows (batch)
Its own taste.md so the notes sound like you
